Parent: zaq-ic9.14. Read the parent contract and inherited policies before work. This task stays blocked until its recorded prerequisite is complete.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Extend lib/zaq/agent/executor.ex success result and lib/zaq/agent/pipeline.ex result_from_answering/3 to retain final selection. Use existing Outgoing.from_pipeline_result attachment support and existing Channels materialization/authorization. Verify failure and suppressed partial results contain no selected files. Preserve textual answer and existing status behavior.

Tests to add before implementation:
Integration tests through configured-agent and default answering Pipeline paths: final selection B after A removal, empty replacement, text plus files, no early delivery, no file on failed/cancelled request, and Channels authorization at materialization. Ensure incoming attachments are not automatically selected.

Branches/paths validated:
Cover success, invalid input/authorization, lifecycle and propagation paths relevant to this step; preserve the parent's add/remove/replace, atomicity, request isolation and privacy invariants.

Mocking plan:
Keep internal ZAQ and Jido boundaries real where supported; mock only external model/provider/network edges. No shared global test configuration. Discovery must identify any hard constraint before test-only abstractions are added.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Record evidence, decisions and validation in this issue. Update affected module docs and docs/services/agent.md with implementation; final documentation consistency is checked by the validation task. Do not describe proposed behavior as shipped.

Action reuse assessment:
Extend existing result propagation; reuse Outgoing.from_pipeline_result and Channels delivery. No new delivery Action or attachment_refs contract; mapping helpers remain local-only. Evidence: Outgoing already reads result.attachments, while Pipeline result_from_answering currently omits attachments.

Gates:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Discovery must resolve unknown contracts and finalize this step before coding. Existing test behavior changes require explicit human approval. No commit/push/merge implied.

Remaining assertions require original post update with file_ids and original confirmed receipt. Log /tmp/zaq-ic9-14-duplicate-reply-red.log. Production code and existing tests untouched. Deliberately stopping red per user; keep issue and UX gate open. Existing separate-post expectation still needs explicit approval before changing it during future fix.
